status: DRAFT v2 (public version). Labels only: group membership, levels, scam types and ranking constraints. The detailed evidence notes (page excerpts, domains, tracker IDs) come from the organiser's sample data and live in groups.local.json, which is gitignored; ask the author for it. Reviewed by the project owner on 2026-11-21 for cases 36, 5, 1, 2, 3; the other two team members still need to review.
how_to_use: Groups may overlap (a case can belong to several). Each group has a level that says how strong the relation is. Strict evaluation = same_campaign + same_template groups. Broad evaluation = strict + same_scheme. 'ranking_triples' are order constraints that stay meaningful with so few cases: for each, similarity(anchor, closer) must be greater than similarity(anchor, farther).

relation_levels.same_campaign: Identical content and/or identical technical anchors (same pixel, same article text). Only the domain or capture differs.
relation_levels.same_template: Same layout, headline and mechanics, but different surface elements (people, dates, platform name, amounts).
relation_levels.same_scheme: Same scam blueprint (hook -> offer type -> persuasion mechanics), different template and surface.

ranking_triples.reason: identical article vs same scheme only
same template vs different scam type that only shares the TVN24 branding
same investment scheme vs health scheme
same video-sales template vs casino ad
same page template vs ad-only health case

open_questions: See groups.local.json for the open questions (case 36 enum value, what the second capture of case 2 represents, case 3 platform name).
